how_to_use: 1) Read the guide. 2) Log each request on receipt in the request log. 3) Complete identity verification before searching. 4) Scope sources using the registry. 5) Fulfill per the runbook, send the matching letter, and close with a complete audit trail.
limitations: General operational templates only, not jurisdiction-specific advice. Identity, scope, exemption, retention, and deadline decisions require qualified counsel. The kit cannot compel data removal from third parties, backups beyond rotation, or logs that must be retained. No outcome or timeline is promised.
long_description: An operations kit for small SaaS teams handling access and deletion requests without a legal ops function. Built around a 5-stage state machine (Received, Identity verified, Scoped, Fulfilled, Closed) with a 23-business-day internal SLA inside statutory clocks (30 days GDPR, 45 days several US states per the brief). Includes an intake log with SLA-date formulas, identity-verification checklist, data-source registry, deletion runbook, and 4 response letter templates: access fulfilled, deletion confirmed, rejection with basis, and extension notice.

outcome_statement: A team using the kit consistently will have a logged registry of requests, dated verification and scoping records, per-source fulfillment notes, and filed response letters that support orderly handling inside the clocks counsel confirms.
